northStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute
companyRules: No employee may self-certify success, customer acceptance, cleared payment, consent, or legal compliance.
Every mission binds a source main SHA, evidence inputs, tool ceiling, effect ledger, stop conditions, and escalation target.
Add a role only when a repeated measured workflow justifies it; role count is not a success metric.

departments.mission: Convert decision-changing world signals into sourced observations, contradictions, opportunity evidence, and bounded implementation packets.

roles.mission: Observe only signal classes in artifacts/world-signal-taxonomy.json.
roles.economicMetric: decision-changing verified signals per provider dollar and founder minute
roles.receipt: canonical MarketSignal candidate plus source reference

roles.mission: Resolve buyer, trigger, current alternative, downstream leverage, and public-contact provenance for the selected canary.
roles.economicMetric: qualified evidence-complete accounts per founder minute
stopConditions: target does not show home-service specialization or downstream leverage
roles.receipt: account evidence packet without unnecessary personal data

roles.mission: Extract reusable mechanisms, licenses, overlap, and missing gaps from current products and repositories.
roles.economicMetric: verified founder-minute reduction or revenue-leverage hypotheses per reviewed mechanism

roles.mission: Maintain current official price anchors and compute only receipt-supported contribution ranges.
roles.economicMetric: percentage of material cost components backed by fresh receipts
roles.receipt: cost anchor or UNKNOWN plus contradiction

roles.mission: Challenge source class, contradiction handling, inference boundaries, and claims of demand or success.
roles.economicMetric: material false promotions prevented per review

departments.mission: Move an evidence-qualified account through a lawful, attributable path without treating activity as revenue.

roles.mission: Find agencies with verifiable home-service specialization and downstream-account leverage.
roles.economicMetric: evidence-qualified downstream accounts per researched partner and founder minute

roles.mission: Classify fit, trigger, authority, timing, and offer mismatch from buyer-origin evidence.
roles.economicMetric: accepted paid pilots per qualified conversation, with founder minutes

roles.mission: Compile one bounded audience, offer, channel, cost ceiling, measurement window, and kill threshold.
roles.economicMetric: cleared contribution per founder minute after external outcomes exist

roles.mission: Draft concise evidence-based messages using only supported account facts.
roles.economicMetric: qualified conversations per reviewed draft, never opens

roles.mission: Preserve signal-to-touch-to-payment-to-acceptance lineage and reconcile contradictions.
roles.economicMetric: percentage of consequential events with complete attribution and cost lineage

departments.mission: Compile, deliver, judge, repair, and retain bounded evidence products.

roles.mission: Bind buyer, trigger, scope, exclusions, acceptance, SLA, price hypothesis, and proof package.
roles.economicMetric: accepted deliveries per stable scope version and founder minute

roles.mission: Execute deterministic-first public or sandbox evidence steps within explicit scope.
roles.economicMetric: reproducible findings per provider dollar and operator minute
roles.receipt: step, screenshot/hash, outcome, and effect ledger

roles.mission: Assemble findings, contradictions, reproduction steps, limitations, and hashes into the delivery package.
roles.economicMetric: accepted evidence packages per assembly minute

roles.mission: Judge delivery against external acceptance criteria and hostile invariants.
roles.economicMetric: escaped material defects and repair minutes
stopConditions: judge would be evaluating its own unsupported claim

roles.mission: Detect a real monitoring, renewal, adjacent-site, or referral trigger after accepted delivery.
roles.economicMetric: cleared renewal or expansion contribution per founder minute
roles.receipt: renewal or expansion opportunity with lineage

departments.mission: Turn measured gaps and economics into minimal, testable implementation packets and allocation decisions.

roles.mission: Reconcile provider, payment, delivery, support, refund, dispute, and founder-minute costs.
roles.economicMetric: share of contribution equation backed by trusted receipts

roles.mission: Keep one canary and one fallback; reallocate only from evidence.
roles.economicMetric: risk-adjusted cleared contribution per founder minute

roles.mission: Map the selected commercial need to existing modules and identify only the smallest missing primitive or adapter.
roles.economicMetric: founder minutes or failure risk removed per implementation unit

roles.mission: Independently verify exact-head deployment and live-capability receipts when implementation is authorized.
roles.economicMetric: false deployment claims prevented and time-to-trusted-release
